title: Hospital hell PT 2
content: (For context this is a real dream I've had and is not made up) In this dream I'm trapped in the 12 story hospital. I dont know what level, how I awoke there or why they wanted me to stay. I ran around the halls trying to find a way out. I was frantically trying to escape and find an exit because I hate hospitals. I found myself in a unsettling lobby with tons of people standing like manicans wearing a yellow hazmat suit with a mask. I thought to myself why was I not wearing one? Why were they all wearing masks? Was the air poisoned? I wasn't sticking around to find out. Once I was spotted by those statues they started moving, turning to look at me. Than the elevator dinged making me jump out of my skin. A boss looking man with a keycard was heading towards me in a panic , on my left a male security gaurd was heading my way angerly and on my right a nurse was coming towards me in a panic. They all were trying to stop me from escaping like I was a resident. So I freaked out and was looking for the exit. It happened to just appear behind me in the moment. But it lead to a balcony. I was fighting my way to the exit as I started to feel like I was gunna pass out. Something was poisoning the air. All 3 of those people that were trying to stop me fought there way running to get me. As I grabbed the door the boss man grabbed my ankle. I kicked him in the face and fell through the door. He hit the floor. All 3 were dead on the cold hospital floor as I sat against the balcony railing balling my eyes out just wanting to wake up from this walking nightmare. If I would have waited any longer I would have watched myself die or would have had to redo that whole experience again.
